themes_detail.label: Abandoned vehicles surge
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned vehicle complaints spiked to 17 THIS WEEK, a 312% increase vs. 4.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks, signaling either a new dumping pattern or accelerated enforcement attention in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 17 abandoned vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.84)
312% spike represents sharpest week-to-week anomaly in current dataset
Spatial concentration in single community district suggests localized problem, not citywide trend
reporting_angles: Canvass blocks with highest complaint density to photograph conditions and interview residents
Contact NYPD Towing to determine if new towing operations or policy changes triggered spike

themes_detail.label: Sewer system strain
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints jumped to 8 THIS WEEK, a 357% spike from 1.8 weekly average, potentially signaling infrastructure failure or backup issues affecting multiple blocks in the district.
evidence: 8 sewer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.21)
357% increase in single week suggests acute event rather than gradual deterioration
Complements long-running 'unsanitary condition' complaint volume (685 over 90 days), indicating sanitation infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Request DEP incident logs and maintenance records for this district in past 7 days
Interview residents in blocks with multiple sewer complaints to document raw sewage, backed-up drains, odors

themes_detail.label: Street noise spike
themes_detail.summary: Street/sidewalk noise complaints surged to 21 THIS WEEK, a 190% increase from 7.2 weekly average, combined with general noise complaints up 226% last week—suggesting either construction activity or enforcement pattern change affecting outdoor areas.
evidence: Street/sidewalk noise: 21 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.21)
General residential noise: 22 complaints last week vs. 6.8 weekly baseline (z-score: 6.26)
313 building permits filed in 90 days (176 alteration, 88 new) may correlate with construction-related noise
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 noise complaints against active DOB permits to identify construction sites
Determine if NYPD noise enforcement activity increased or if complaints reflect genuine uptick in late-night activity

themes_detail.label: Asbestos hazard alerts
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints reached 11 LAST WEEK, a 1157% spike from 0.9 weekly average—the highest z-score anomaly in dataset (9.61)—indicating potential widespread building violations or renovation disturbances in aging housing stock.
evidence: 11 asbestos complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.61, tied for highest severity)
1157% spike in single week suggests acute event—possible renovation work exposing material or public health investigation
176 building alterations filed in 90 days in district may include improper asbestos abatement
reporting_angles: Obtain NYC Department of Environmental Protection inspection records for asbestos-related violations in past 14 days
Interview building tenants and workers at addresses with recent asbestos complaints to document health concerns and remediation status
Investigate whether renovation permits required asbestos surveys and whether work was properly licensed and monitored

themes_detail.label: Maintenance failures at schools
themes_detail.summary: School maintenance complaints hit 4 THREE WEEKS AGO (vs. 0.6 weekly baseline), a 540% anomaly—compounded by district's repeated budget requests for facility upgrades, suggesting chronic deferred maintenance affecting student environment.
evidence: 4 school maintenance complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 3.94)
Community Board budget requests include 'Renovate or upgrade a senior center' and capital requests suggesting long-standing infrastructure gaps
Spike predates this week but represents elevated alert threshold for school systems in district
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Department of Education about maintenance backlog in Flatbush/PLG schools
Contact District 13 school principals to document specific maintenance failures (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, mold, windows)
